reason: Adds E211 (shell without unsafe_shell = true), E212 (command and shell forms conflict), E213 (placeholder not a whole command element or inside shell text), W409 (unsafe_shell in use), W410 (cwd = untrusted-current) and W411 (script starts with #!/usr/bin/env). Every existing code keeps its number, status, arguments and text; no code is reused or deprecated.

W411 still means: the script a command segment would run is refused by its first line, so it will not run. It now reports every first line the executor refuses (the executor's own rule: `#!/usr/bin/env` or an interpreter that is /usr/bin/env under another name, a relative interpreter, a line over 256 bytes, a NUL), naming which in a new {reason} argument, where it named only the first case before; {id} and {path} keep their meaning and the fix is unchanged. Its number, status and severity stay; no code is reused or deprecated.
